claim_scope: Development-only 0 K relaxed-transfer diagnostic using the forward-default AM1-BCC/OBC-II/ACE pairing. For each frozen start, the gas phase is minimized with MACE-OFF23 medium and the solution phase is minimized with the same MACE potential plus fixed-AM1-BCC/OBC-II/ACE forces. The reported transfer energy is a potential-energy difference between separately relaxed minima, not a finite-temperature hydration free energy, basin integral, RRHO correction, lambda-path estimate, or confirmation result.

cases.name: alachlor
cases.selection_role: largest first-stage conformational correction and influence stress test

cases.name: isobutyl nitrate
cases.selection_role: limited-flexibility polar case with distinct solution-dominant start

limitations: Only the reference, gas-dominant, and solution-dominant first-stage states are started; this is not exhaustive conformer search on the MACE surfaces.
Separate 0 K minimization does not include conformer entropy, vibrational free energy, standard-state terms, or solvent sampling.
Fixed AM1-BCC charges do not respond to geometry or solvent polarization.
OBC-II and ACE remain the solvent model; MACE only improves the intramolecular potential and its forces.
Agreement with experiment is reported only as a development diagnostic and cannot validate the thermodynamic estimator.
next_gate: Compare the AM1-BCC relaxed diagnostic against its endpoint and discrete-weighted baselines and against historical ABCG2 evidence. Proceed to finite-temperature sampling only if relaxation is stable across starts and adds information beyond the charge-model switch.
